_comment: Sealed v0.1.0 source identity (Phase A, M1 round 4).
tools/verify_reproduction.py anchors provenance validation to this FIXED
must equal this sealed pair or the canonical bundle's recorded pair,
validated atomically. The expectation never derives from the current
working tree: an edited tree cannot validate its own runs, and a correct
sealed-identity reproduction keeps passing regardless of later tree edits.
This file lives in unhashed tools/ so it can state the hash
without changing it. Any legitimate change to hashed source (src/**/*.py,
scripts/*.py, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt) must deliberately update
this file; tests/test_verify_reproduction.py contains a guard test that
fails loudly when this seal and the working tree disagree, so staleness
surfaces as a test failure, never as a silent wrong PASS.

sealed.source_identifier_note: content hash over sorted src/**/*.py, scripts/*.py, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt — not a VCS revision; identifies the exact source that produced this run independent of version-control state
